newsitem.title: USA: MedAmicus posts Q1 profit on sales gain.
newsitem.headline: MedAmicus posts Q1 profit on sales gain.

text.p: MedAmicus Inc said a solid sales increase helped the company post a profit in the first quarter ended March 31 compared to a loss a year ago.

The company reported net income of $7,115, or nil a share, versus a loss of $333,228, or $0.10 a share, in the same period last year. Sales in the period rose to $1.8 million from $1.2 million a year ago.
MedAmicus, a medical products company, said it continues to benefit from its supply agreement with Medtronic Inc, which is facing increased demand for its own product line.
The company's shares were up 1/8 Thursday at 2-5/8.
